title: Repo skill, installed skill, and version guard drift apart and silently stale the AI's rules
symptom: The repo skill points at v2/v3 while the standalone version guard still cites an old 0.3.1 SHA and the installed skill still marks current strict-2D as a legacy defect; the agent then overrides fresh MCP profile data with stale rules.
root_cause: Three copies of the same knowledge (repo skill, installed skill, guard script) update at different times; nothing cross-checks them.
minimal_fix: On every rule change, sync repo skill AND installed copies in the same commit; make the version guard judge by profile id (not a hardcoded SHA); self-test must verify installed/repo hash equality.
validation: Self-test hashes installed vs repo skill bundles (74/74 includes these checks).
avoid: Editing one copy only; treating an old defect list as current without checking the active profile.

parameters.rule: sync repo + installed skills in one commit; guard by profile id
